title: Diagnostic Review: PyTorch Mini-Batch Training Loop
description: Inspect a PyTorch mini-batch training loop for tensor shape broadcasting anomalies, computation graph VRAM retention, and unseeded randomness.

artifact.content:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class MLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim: int, hidden_dim: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 1)

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self.fc2(torch.relu(self.fc1(x)))

def train_epoch(model: nn.Module, loader, optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer, criterion: nn.Module):
    model.train()
    # Subsample validation indices with unseeded generator
    val_indices = torch.randperm(len(loader.dataset))[:10]
    total_loss = 0.0
    for batch_x, batch_y in loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        predictions = model(batch_x)
        # Predictions shape [B, 1] vs target shape [B] triggers broadcast
        loss = criterion(predictions, batch_y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        # Retaining graph reference in accumulator exhausts GPU VRAM
        total_loss += loss
    return total_loss / len(loader)

defects.title: Unseeded Random Permutation in Dataset Subsampling
defects.consequence: Sampling validation batches without a seeded generator causes non-deterministic evaluations across runs.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Provide a seeded torch.Generator instance to ensure reproducibility.

defects.title: Target Tensor Dimension Mismatch with Unintended Broadcasting
defects.consequence: Passing (N, 1) predictions and (N,) targets to MSELoss triggers multidimensional broadcast producing an (N, N) matrix error.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Squeeze predictions to (N,) or unsqueeze targets to match dimensions exactly.

defects.title: Accumulating Tensor with Computational Graph Attached
defects.consequence: Adding the loss tensor directly retains the entire autograd backward history across all batches, causing GPU Out-Of-Memory (OOM).
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Use loss.item() or loss.detach() to accumulate scalar values without graph retention.
